scripts.benchmark: npm run benchmark:web && npm run benchmark:rust
scripts.check: npm run check:boundaries && npm run check:scope && npm run check:frontend && npm run check:rust
scripts.check:frontend: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:web
scripts.check:rust: mkdir -p .tmp/test-tmp && TMPDIR="$PWD/.tmp/test-tmp" sh -c 'cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace --locked'
scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test:rust
scripts.test:e2e: mkdir -p .tmp/test-tmp && TMPDIR="$PWD/.tmp/test-tmp" sh -c "vitest run src/App.test.tsx src/jobs/ConflictDialog.test.tsx src/jobs/BottomFeedback.test.tsx && cargo test -p panedeck-app --test mvp_e2e --locked"
scripts.test:e2e:v2: mkdir -p .tmp/test-tmp && TMPDIR="$PWD/.tmp/test-tmp" sh -c "vitest run src/App.test.tsx src/browser/VirtualFileList.test.tsx src/browser/directoryTree.test.ts src/browser/treeWatchCoordinator.test.ts src/commands/contextMenu.test.tsx src/commands/routing.test.tsx src/jobs/ConflictDialog.test.tsx src/jobs/BottomFeedback.test.tsx src/jobs/operationEvents.test.ts src/jobs/useOperationEvents.test.tsx && cargo test -p panedeck-app --test mvp_e2e --locked"
scripts.test:e2e:v3: mkdir -p .tmp/test-tmp && TMPDIR="$PWD/.tmp/test-tmp" sh -c "vitest run src/App.test.tsx src/accessibility.test.tsx src/performance.test.tsx src/browser/VirtualFileList.test.tsx src/browser/directoryTree.test.ts src/browser/treeWatchCoordinator.test.ts src/commands/contextMenu.test.tsx src/commands/routing.test.tsx src/jobs/ConflictDialog.test.tsx src/jobs/BottomFeedback.test.tsx src/jobs/operationEvents.test.ts src/jobs/useOperationEvents.test.tsx && cargo test -p panedeck-app --test mvp_e2e --locked"
